germ_layer_doublet_specimen.species: Danio rerio (zebrafish blastoderm / gastrula cross-transplantation showing GFP-labeled green and RFP-labeled red progenitor populations sorting into layered and mushroom-doublet configurations)

dith_interfacial_tension_mechanics.section: Brodland (2002) J. Biomech. Eng. 124:188-197 Eqs. (1)-(6); Krieg et al. (2008) Nat. Cell Biol. 10:429-436; Maître et al. (2012) Science 338:253-256
dith_interfacial_tension_mechanics.young_dupre_contact_angle_formula: cos(theta) = 1 - gamma_{cc} / (2 * gamma_{cm}) = (2 * beta^{cort} - gamma_{cc}) / (2 * beta^{cort})
dith_interfacial_tension_mechanics.doublet_contact_radius_formula: r_c / R_cell = sin(theta) = sqrt(1 - (1 - gamma_{cc} / (2 * gamma_{cm}))^2)

krieg_2008_zebrafish_germ_layer_paramete.omega_heterotypic_note: Pass 3 correction: the Pass 2 file listed omega_EM=35, omega_MN=45, omega_EN=35, which contradict the gamma_het = 30 pN/um anchor under gamma = beta_a + beta_b - omega (50+95-35 = 110, not 30). The values above are the effective closure values implied by gamma_EM = gamma_MN = gamma_EN = 30 pN/um; they are model closures, not measured adhesion energies.

perturbation_regimes_krieg_2008.label: Wild-Type Germ-Layer Engulfment (Ectoderm Envelops Mesoderm/Endoderm Core)
perturbation_regimes_krieg_2008.description: Wild-type zebrafish gastrula: beta_E (50 pN/um) < beta_M (95 pN/um) < beta_N (130 pN/um), satisfying 0 < gamma_EM (30) < gamma_M0 - gamma_E0 (45), so low-tension ectoderm envelops high-tension mesoderm/endoderm.

perturbation_regimes_krieg_2008.label: caMLCK Ectoderm Cortex Stiffening (Inverted Sorting: Ectoderm Core Inside Mesoderm Shell)
perturbation_regimes_krieg_2008.description: Krieg et al. (2008) Fig. 4: overexpression of constitutively active Myosin Light Chain Kinase (caMLCK) in ectoderm raises beta_E to 145 pN/um > beta_M = 95 pN/um, inverting the engulfment hierarchy so ectoderm sorts to the interior.

perturbation_regimes_krieg_2008.label: Blebbistatin Myosin-II Inhibition (Collapsed Cortical Tension & Sorting Arrest)
perturbation_regimes_krieg_2008.description: Krieg et al. (2008) Fig. 3: (-)-blebbistatin inhibits non-muscle Myosin-II, equalizing cortical tensions (beta_E = beta_M = 25 pN/um, gamma_EM = 0) and abolishing germ-layer sorting.

perturbation_regimes_krieg_2008.label: High Heterotypic Interfacial Tension (Asymmetric Mushroom / Acorn Doublet)
perturbation_regimes_krieg_2008.description: Maître et al. (2012) & Canty et al. (2017): when heterotypic interfacial tension gamma_EM = 70 exceeds |gamma_M0 - gamma_E0| = 45, complete engulfment gives way to a partially sorted asymmetric mushroom doublet.

nodal_tgfb_cortical_tension_coupling_pas.section: Pass 3 reduced model: time-dependent marginal Nodal/TGF-beta field -> dose-dependent germ-layer cortical tension (Section 1b / 2b of the script)
nodal_tgfb_cortical_tension_coupling_pas.nodal_field_formula: C(x, t) = C0 * (1 - exp(-(t - t_on)/tau_N)) * exp(-x / lambda)  for t >= t_on, else 0
nodal_tgfb_cortical_tension_coupling_pas.tension_target_formula: beta*(C) = beta_E + (beta_M - beta_E) * H(C; K_M) + (beta_N - beta_M) * H(C; K_N),  H(C; K) = C^n / (K^n + C^n)
nodal_tgfb_cortical_tension_coupling_pas.tension_relaxation_formula: d beta_i / dt = (beta*(C(x_i, t)) - beta_i) / tau_beta
nodal_tgfb_cortical_tension_coupling_pas.continuous_cortex_closure_formula: gamma_i0 = beta_i,  gamma_ij = gamma_hom + kappa * |beta_i - beta_j|  (omega_ij = beta_i + beta_j - gamma_ij), 0 <= kappa < 1

nodal_progenitor_induction_by_dose.value: lefty1 -> ectoderm; cyclops -> mesoderm; cyclops + casanova -> endoderm
nodal_progenitor_induction_by_dose.status: experimental design of the AFM measurements

mesendoderm_signalling_domain_tiers_at_s.status: approximate, recalled, not digitised in this pass

nodal_null_no_mesendoderm.value: MZoep / lefty1: no mesoderm or endoderm, hence no germ-layer sorting

time_dependent_specification_window.value: Nodal required between sphere and shield; later signalling cannot rescue

nodal_tgfb_cortical_tension_coupling_pas.reduction_disclosure: 1D gradient in tier distance from the margin; Nodal exposure fixed to the tier of origin (specification memory); no epiboly / YSL motion; no Lefty feedback; kappa closure phenomenological.
